symptom: mendixlabs/mxcli#1319: an `import from mapping M.IMM($Json) first` activity already IN the model, over an OBJECT-rooted mapping, stores ForceSingleOccurrence=true + Range.SingleObject=true; `mxcli lint` said "No issues found.", `mx check` "0 errors", and the activity threw `key not found: Path(QName(None,),None,)` when it ran. check's MDL-MAP04 refuses the statement, but only in a script — models written by v0.24.0 or with `exec --no-check` were found by nothing
cause: MDL-MAP04 existed only as a check-time AST rule (validate_import_mapping_range.go). No lint rule read the stored ImportMappingCall flags against the mapping's root shape, and the shape helpers lived in the executor, which the lint rules package cannot import
file: `mdl/linter/rules/import_range_object_mapping.go` (new lint rule, same ID MDL-MAP04, registered in `cmd/mxcli/cmd_lint.go` builtinLintRules); `types.JsonMappingRootIsList` / `MappingRootPathCrossesArray` moved from `mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_calls.go` to `mdl/types/mapping_shape.go`; example `mdl-examples/bug-tests/1319-lint-first-on-object-rooted-mapping.mdl`
insight: **A check-time rule guards only what passes through check; anything that can be written around it (older binaries, --no-check, Studio Pro, hand edits) needs a model-level twin.** When adding a check rule for a runtime-only failure, ask at once whether the same defect can already be IN models — if so ship the lint half with it. Key the model rule on the same shape decision as the builder/check (share the helper, don't re-derive it): the flags alone are NOT the defect, since a list-rooted mapping stores the identical FSO/Range pair for Studio Pro's legitimate First. Report either flag alone (#242 measured FSO=true/Range=false failing too). LintReader lacks mapping lookups: assert an optional interface on ctx.Reader() rather than widening LintReader, so test doubles stay valid. E2E without mxbuild: copy testdata/testapp-views (11.14.0), `exec --no-check` the broken script, `lint -r MDL-MAP04`; control = the pre-fix binary on the same model prints "No issues found."
